Name: Retro Slate
Description: Turn your Stream Deck and your computer into a retro drawing slate: two knobs, one line, shake to erase.

com.medilase.retro-slate.knob.Name: Knob
com.medilase.retro-slate.knob.Tooltip: Stream Deck + dial: turn to draw, press to change speed, touch the screen to shake.

com.medilase.retro-slate.arrow.Name: Arrow
com.medilase.retro-slate.arrow.Tooltip: Hold to draw in one of 8 directions.

com.medilase.retro-slate.shake.Name: Shake
com.medilase.retro-slate.shake.Tooltip: Press to shake the slate a little. Hold for one second to erase everything.

com.medilase.retro-slate.slate.Name: Slate
com.medilase.retro-slate.slate.Tooltip: Live preview of your drawing. Press to open the slate on your computer.

com.medilase.retro-slate.photo.Name: Photo
com.medilase.retro-slate.photo.Tooltip: Save your drawing as a picture in Pictures › Retro Slate.
